g.title: 'grep -o "[A-Za-z0-9]" | sort | uniq -c | awk '\''{print $1, $2}'\'' | tee >(sha256sum > "$tmpfile") | << (SUBSHELL): 1545849 >> | wc -l' (13,094 us, 0.13%)
